up: For assay CHEMBL3885862, list compounds with exact activity measurements. Return canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, standard relation, standard value, and standard units. Only include rows where the standard relation is '='. Do not apply any limits on the number of rows.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
    a.standard_type,
    a.standard_relation,
    a.standard_value,
    a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
    ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3885862'
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
    AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
